purpose: Round-28 captures for the F12 admission (Japanese state-coordinated disclosure workflow). S041.txt is the round-28 re-capture of the JPCERT/CC 情報セキュリティ早期警戒パートナーシップガイドライン 2026年10月 (its bytes are identical to the round-26 capture, sha256 e18acbf9…); S042.txt is the new capture of the IPA 脆弱性関連情報の届出受付業務における取扱いプロセス page. Both were captured on 2026-10-25 with corpus/instruments/capture-source.py; the sha256 pins bind these committed bytes and corpus/instruments/source-recheck.py asserts every quote below against them. `location` is documentation the instrument does not read; the Q9 binding is path stem == id plus the exactly-once (or anchor) occurrence count the instrument prints.
